How many best friends does Duoduo have now？
For Duoduo, Tutu is his best and
only friend. He wants to play with
Tutu, but Tutu is playing with two
other boys. This makes Duoduo
unhappy. Tutu asks Duoduo to join
them but Duoduo just walks away.
After a week, Duoduo feels sad
and he misses Tutu. “But Tutu may
not miss me because he has new
friends，" Duoduo thinks.
Just then, Tutu sits down next to
him. “Hi Duoduo. How are you？”
Tutu asks. “I'm unhappy because
I'm not your friend now，” answers
Duoduo.
“Why do you say that？” says Tutu.
“Yes, I have new friends, but you're
still my friend. Old friends and new
friends are both very nice. Join us
and they can be your friends, too.”
Now Duoduo has three best friends！
